propositions: When a Jira workflow forbids a direct end-state transition (e.g., open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), the outbound sync fails and the ticket drifts.

Replay must reconstruct the recorded intermediate status hops from append-only STATUS events, forward-map them to Jira names, and execute them in chronological order via the existing transition_issue_by_name seam.
Current status matching must occur in Jira-name space without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map; resume resumes after the last positional match in the recorded hop sequence.
Replay aborts if any intermediate hop raises RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError, falling back to comment-fallback + drift as today.
The replay function is called from _update_one_scalar_update and requires local_id parameter threading from the mutation context.
Replay is skipped when local_id is absent, preserving today's comment-fallback behavior.
